Theorem
[Davies' double integral upper bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0382, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0383, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0384 ↗ lem:chow-iii-noncompact-heat-kernel-semigroup ↗ lem:chow-iii-weighted-l2-heat-estimate 1. ch26:26.32\group Heat Kernel Upper Bounds

For a complete static Riemannian manifold, its heat kernel satisfies \[ \int _{U_1}\! \int _{U_2}H(x,y,t)\, d\mu (x)d\mu (y) \le \Vol (U_1)^{1/2}\Vol (U_2)^{1/2} e^{-d(U_1,U_2)^2/(4t)} \] for bounded $U_1,U_2\subset \mathcal M$.
Proof

\sketch Split the kernel at (t/2). For $u_i(z,t)=\int _{U_i}H(z,y,t)\, d\mu (y)$, use Cauchy–Schwarz with the weights $e^{d(z,U_i)^2/(2t)}$. Their weighted $L^2$ norms decrease by the Davies monotonicity calculation and converge at time zero to $\Vol (U_i)$. The triangle inequality supplies the displayed Gaussian.

□
